# The Global Meridian (দ্য গ্লোবাল মেরিডিয়ান)

> Independent multilingual international news journal covering Europe, the Middle East, the Americas, Russia, China, India, Africa, Japan, and South Korea across world diplomacy, global politics, macroeconomics, technology, defense, climate policy, and science.

- [Politics](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/politics): Multilateral summits, EU/Russia diplomacy, Indo-Pacific, Korean Peninsula, Japan & Americas governance
- [Business](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/business): US Fed, ECB, Bank of Japan & yen policy, China-Brazil trade, India-Middle East corridors
- [Technology](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/technology): SK Hynix & Korean semiconductors, agentic AI security, 6G spectrum, robotics
- [Science](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/science): Deep space, climate research, mRNA breakthroughs, energy systems
- [Defense](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/defense): Hormuz & Red Sea maritime corridors, European security, orbital verification
- [Environment](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/environment): COP31, African adaptation finance, clean transition
- [Opinion](https://the-global-meridian.incognito120120.workers.dev/category/opinion): Geoeconomic and policy analysis
